incidents.title: CONTSHIP JET — reported attack
incidents.location_summary: Black Sea near Cape Kaliakra, off Bulgaria

timeline.title: Reuters verified footage and reported the sinking and evacuation. The vessel operator said all 18 crew were rescued.

Ukraine’s letter circulated by the United Nations records the 28 October incident near Cape Kaliakra and the rescue of all 18 crew. The letter describes the operational details as subject to further verification.
timeline.source: Ukraine’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations

properties.review_note: The classification layer records high-probability cloud at the reported position. The acquisition precedes the time stated in the maritime notice by about an hour.

The acquisition is 42 h 13 min after the time in the maritime notice. The SeaCommons detector produced no candidates in the tested crop. This acquisition cannot establish vessel presence at the time of the incident.

osint_lesson.question: The detector returned zero candidates. Did we rule out the ship's presence during the attack?
osint_lesson.observation: The radar crop was acquired 42 h 13 min after the maritime notice time. The SeaCommons detector returned zero candidates in that crop.
osint_lesson.interpretation: The detector result applies to the pixels, place, acquisition time and settings used for the later scene.
osint_lesson.limit: The crop cannot establish what was present during the attack, or what happened at a different location.

properties.review_note: Optical pass 22 h 51 min after the maritime notice time. The local quality mask and visible bands were checked.

osint_lesson.question: The catalog reports 3.9% cloud cover. Is this crop usable to identify the ship?
osint_lesson.observation: In the 83 × 80 pixel crop around the reported point, all 6,640 QA_PIXEL samples set both the clear bit and the high-confidence snow bit. The central pixel also has very high visible-band reflectance.
osint_lesson.interpretation: The clear bit only describes two cloud flags. A snow classification over this offshore crop is a quality inconsistency. The two bits do not identify the obscuring material or establish a clear view of the sea.
osint_lesson.limit: This crop cannot corroborate vessel presence, absence, identity or damage. The tile-wide cloud estimate cannot override the local quality check.
